arxiv-2208-03317.title: Image Quality Assessment: Learning to Rank Image Distortion Level
arxiv-2208-03317.creator: Shira Faigenbaum-Golovin Or Shimshi
arxiv-2208-03317.description: Abstract Over the years, various algorithms were developed, attempting to imitate the Human Visual System (HVS), and evaluate the perceptual image quality. However, for certain image distortions, the functionality of the HVS continues to be an enigma, and echoing its behavior remains a challenge (especially for ill-defined distortions).

arxiv-2209-02342.title: Internal mechanical dissipation mechanisms in amorphous silicon
arxiv-2209-02342.creator: Carl Lévesque, Sjoerd Roorda, François Schiettekatte, Normand Mousseau
arxiv-2209-02342.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Carl Lévesque, Sjoerd Roorda, François Schiettekatte, Normand Mousseau. Using the Activation-Relaxation Technique-nouveau, we search for two-level systems (TLSs) in models of amorphous silicon ( a -Si). The TLSs are mechanisms related to internal mechanical dissipation and represent the main source of noise in the most sensitive frequency range of the largest gravitational wave detectors as well as one of the main sources of decoherence in many quantum computers.

arxiv-2212-12426.title: Effects of Lorentz Symmetry Breaking Environment on Generalized Relativistic Quantum Oscillator Field
arxiv-2212-12426.description: Abstract In this paper, we study the generalized Klein-Gordon oscillator under the effects of the violation of Lorentz Symmetry defined by a tensor field ( K F ) μ ​ ν ​ α ​ β (K_{F})_{\mu\nu\alpha\beta} out of the Standard Model Extension (SME).

arxiv-2306-12972.title: Designing Individualized Policy and Technology Interventions to Improve Gig Work Conditions Conference: Annual Symposium on Human-Computer Interaction for Work 2023; June 13–16, 2023; Oldenburg, Germany Annual Symposium on Human-Computer Interaction for Work 2023 (CHIWORK 2023), June 13–16, 2023, Ol
arxiv-2306-12972.creator: Jane Hsieh, Oluwatobi Adisa, Sachi Bafna, Haiyi Zhu
arxiv-2306-12972.description: Abstract . The gig economy is characterized by short-term contract work completed by independent workers who are paid to perform “gigs”, and who have control over when, whether and how they conduct work. Gig economy platforms (e.g., Uber, Lyft, Instacart) offer workers increased job opportunities, lower barriers to entry, and improved flexibility.

arxiv-2308-05660.title: Thermodynamic Linear Algebra
arxiv-2308-05660.creator: Maxwell Aifer, Kaelan Donatella, Max Hunter Gordon, Samuel Duffield, Thomas Ahle, Daniel Simpson, Gavin Crooks, Patrick J. Coles
arxiv-2308-05660.description: Abstract Linear algebra is central to many algorithms in engineering, science, and machine learning; hence, accelerating it would have tremendous economic impact. Quantum computing has been proposed for this purpose, although the resource requirements are far beyond current technological capabilities. We consider an alternative physics-based computing paradigm based on classical thermodynamics, to provide a near-term approach to accelerating linear algebra.

arxiv-2412-01323.title: TOrsion-Bar Antenna: A Ground-Based Detector for Low-Frequency Gravity Gradient Measurement
arxiv-2412-01323.creator: Satoru Takano, Tomofumi Shimoda, Yuka Oshima, Ching Pin Ooi, Perry William Fox Forsyth, Mengdi Cao, Kentaro Komori, Yuta Michimura, Ryosuke Sugimoto, Nobuki Kame, Shingo Watada, Takaaki Yokozawa, Shinji Miyoki, Tatsuki Washimi, Masaki Ando
arxiv-2412-01323.description: Abstract The Torsion-Bar Antenna (TOBA) is a torsion pendulum-based gravitational detector developed to observe gravitational waves in frequencies between 1 mHz 1\text{\,}\mathrm{m}\mathrm{H}\mathrm{z} and 10 Hz 10\text{\,}\mathrm{H}\mathrm{z} . The low resonant frequency of the torsion pendulum enables observation in this frequency band on the ground.

arxiv-2507-09948.title: Iceberg: Enhancing HLS Modeling with Synthetic Data
arxiv-2507-09948.creator: Zijian Ding, Tung Nguyen, Weikai Li, Aditya Grover, Yizhou Sun, Jason Cong
arxiv-2507-09948.description: Abstract Deep learning-based prediction models for High-Level Synthesis (HLS) of hardware designs often struggle to generalize. In this paper, we study how to close the generalizability gap of these models through pretraining on synthetic data and introduce Iceberg, a synthetic data augmentation approach that expands both large language model (LLM)-generated programs and weak labels of unseen design configurations.

arxiv-2509-18575.title: The Ranking Blind Spot: Decision Hijacking in LLM-based Text Ranking
arxiv-2509-18575.creator: Yaoyao Qian, Yifan Zeng, Yuchao Jiang, Chelsi Jain, Huazheng Wang
arxiv-2509-18575.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong performance in information retrieval tasks like passage ranking. Our research examines how instruction-following capabilities in LLMs interact with multi-document comparison tasks, identifying what we term the “Ranking Blind Spot”—a characteristic of LLM decision processes during comparative evaluation.

arxiv-2509-21566.title: Cocycle stability in permutations of random simplicial complexes
arxiv-2509-21566.creator: Michael Chapman, Yuval Peled
arxiv-2509-21566.description: Abstract . The cocycle stability rate of a simplicial complex measures how far cochains with small coboundaries are from actual cocycles. In this paper, we study the 1 1 -dimensional cocycle stability rate with permutation coefficients of random 2 2 -dimensional Linial–Meshulam complexes.

arxiv-2509-22093.title: Action-aware Dynamic Pruning for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Manipulation
arxiv-2509-22093.creator: Xiaohuan Pei, Yuxing Chen, Siyu Xu, Yunke Wang, Yuheng Shi, Chang Xu
arxiv-2509-22093.description: Abstract Robotic manipulation with Vision-Language-Action models requires efficient inference over long-horizon multi-modal context, where attention to dense visual tokens dominates computational cost. Existing methods optimize inference speed by reducing visual redundancy within VLA models, but they overlook the varying redundancy across robotic manipulation stages.

pmc-10597076.title: Violence against healthcare workers: a health system approach and international comparative study
pmc-10597076.creator: E Kuhlmann, M Falkenbach, G Lotta, T Tenbensel, A Dopfer-Jablonka
pmc-10597076.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundViolence against healthcare workers is a global health problem threatening healthcare workforce retention and health system resilience in a fragile post-COVID ‘normalisation’ period. There is an urgent need for action to make violence against healthcare a greater priority. Our novel contribution to the debate is a comparative health system and policy approach, aiming to explore major trends and identify policy gaps.MethodsWe have chosen a most different systems comparative approach concerning the epidemiological, political, and geographic contexts.

pmc-10734024.title: Late Magmatic Activity in the Tarim Large Igneous Province: Evidence from the Puchang Granites
pmc-10734024.creator: Zhuang Min, Zhengle Chen, Jiayong Pan, Qing Zhang, Hailong Huo, Fengbin Han, Wengao Zhang, Xiaohu Wang, Yu Wu
pmc-10734024.description: The magmatic evolution sequence and tectonic activity background of the Permian Tarim large igneous province were discussed based on the research of petrogeochemistry, chronology, and zircon Lu–Hf isotope of two types of granite distributed in the Puchang V–Ti–magnetite deposit in the northwestern margin of Tarim.

pmc-12518000.creator: Jatuporn Hongthongkham, Charinrat Srivarom, Naphat Joomdok, Surachai Rattanasuk
pmc-12518000.description: Eleutherine palmifolia (L.) Merr., or Wan Hom Daeng, is a medicinal plant valued for its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antibacterial properties. Its bulbs contain flavonoids, phenolics, and naphthoquinones, but slow natural propagation and low seed viability hinder large-scale cultivation and conservation. This study evaluated the optimal Clorox concentration and exposure time for sterilizing E.

pmc-12546829.title: Pharmacokinetic, docking, and DFT analyses reveal Moringa oleifera phytochemicals as inhibitors of HIF-1α/VEGF/GLUT1 signaling pathway in breast cancer
pmc-12546829.creator: Neha Masarkar, Maynak Pal, Alakesh Bisai, Ashish K Yadav, Mithun Roy, Suman Kumar Ray, Jagat R Kanwar, Sukhes Mukherjee
pmc-12546829.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Breast cancer is among the most heterogeneous and aggressive malignancies. Hypoxia-driven activation of Hypoxia-inducible factor-1 alpha (HIF-1α) in breast cancers triggers the transcription of a battery of genes that facilitate tumor progression and result in poor prognosis.

pmc-13024122.title: The Impact of AI-Assisted Learning on the Agency of Foreign Language Learners: A Meta-Analysis
pmc-13024122.creator: Fengyu Zai, Xiaoyong Zhou
pmc-13024122.description: This study employs a meta-analytic approach to synthesize empirical evidence on the impact of AI-assisted learning on the agency of foreign language learners. The overall synthesis indicates positive associations between AI-assisted learning and multiple dimensions of learner agency; however, the magnitude of these associations varies substantially across studies.

pmc-13330283.title: Compartment-specific phase compensation between pulmonary T-Cell immunity and waning systemic responses in BA.5 breakthrough infection
pmc-13330283.creator: Peiyu Huang, Xinyue Mei, Hao Xu, Qi Wan, Xiaohui Wu, Jieqi Peng, Kunning Zhou, Gang Yang, Li Cheng, Shijun Bu, Zhishan Deng, Fan Wu, Cuiqiong Dai, Daxiang Chen, Qi Luo, Xi Sun, Jie Su, Shidong Deng, Siying Wang, Yufen Liu, Pixin Ran, Zhongfang Wang, Yumin Zhou
pmc-13330283.description: BackgroundSpatiotemporal coordination of SARS-CoV-2-specific immunity across pulmonary and systemic compartments is poorly defined, especially how chronic lung diseases modulate this. We hypothesized that profiling virus-specific T cells (VSTs) and antibodies in respiratory vs. blood samples would reveal compartmentalized dynamics critical for viral control.MethodsIn 64 mild Omicron BA.
